rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a suburban or outlying area.

example.english: We moved to the outskirts to live, and it’s much quieter there.
example.traditional: 我哋搬咗去郊區住，環境清靜好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bun1 zo2 heoi3 gaau1 keoi1 zyu6 waan4 ging2 cing1 zing6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when specifically referring to the outskirts of a city or town rather than a general suburban district.

example.english: This hotel is on the outskirts of the city, and it takes half an hour to get downtown.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店喺市郊，入城要搭半個鐘頭車。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 hai2 si5 gaau1 jap6 seng2 jiu3 daap3 bun3 go3 zung1 tau4 ce1
